model.name: contract-small-step-semantics-v1
model.relation: A finite trace T and contract C evaluate by deterministic small steps: well-formedness, service projection, signal obligations, correlation, temporal obligations, alternative disjunctions, and optional strict closed-world checks. The denotation R is the ordered multiset of checker finding signatures; alignment holds when the small-step denotation equals validate_events(C,T).

rules.meaning: Evaluate contract shape and schema obligations before telemetry obligations.

rules.name: CORRELATION

rules.meaning: Check finite ordered sequences within declared incident windows.
rules.name: TEMPORAL

rules.meaning: Evaluate required finite disjunctions over equivalent evidence paths.
rules.name: ALTERNATIVE

rules.meaning: Optionally strengthen satisfaction with closed-world checks.
rules.name: STRICT
